name: Pathfinder — hobby rocket: flight computer, camera, parachute, physics and CAD

requirements.text: Boot: barometer and IMU pass the self-test; the pyro channel is off at reset; the board waits safe on the pad.
Arming: the arm switch calibrates ground pressure, powers the camera and starts recording before launch.
Launch and burnout: launch is detected from axial acceleration; burnout is detected between T+1.9 s and T+2.3 s (motor burn ends at 2.12 s).
Apogee deployment: the pyro channel fires after true apogee (T+8.885 s in the CAD-mass flight, 8.835 s after launch detection) and no later than T+10.0 s, then switches off after 1 s.
Recovery: landing is detected, the camera stops recording and powers off, the flight summary reports apogee 355-372 m (simulated 364 m), and all outputs end safe.

model_boundary: Firmware phase transitions and saved simulated pressure/acceleration cases are verified; firmware-to-flight dynamics, fabrication, PCB fit and physical flight are not. This is the hobby-rocket showcase, not OLGA.
